name: Menubar for Symfony
description:
Manage local Symfony CLI servers from the top panel.

Requires two things: Symfony CLI (https://symfony.com/download) in PATH, and the helper app symfony-menubar-daemon, which runs the Symfony CLI on this extension's behalf over D-Bus. Installation instructions: https://github.com/tito10047/menubar-for-symfony#installation

* Start/stop servers
* Open in browser
* View logs
* Manage PHP versions
* Proxy status
